body: Video-note cell chrome was laid out against the square bounding box while mediaContainerView is clipped to a circle (clipsToBounds + cornerRadius=D/2), so the duration badge (14,H-32), the download badge (10,10) and the upload size label (8,8) all fell OUTSIDE the circle and were cut in half. Fixed in ChatListCell.layoutMediaSubviews: mute+duration now share one bottom-centre pill inside the rim (mute reparented into mediaVideoInfoBadgeView), and transfer chrome centres on circular cells. The branch also forced mediaVideoInfoBadgeView.isHidden=false, overriding updateMediaTransferChrome, so the duration badge stayed on screen during upload — removed.
author: Vibe Team
